verdict.summary: Equinox Gold is a mid-tier North American gold producer trading at an extreme discount (6.4x forward PE, 6.0x EV/EBITDA) after a 46% drawdown from its 52-week high. The transformative Orla Mining merger (closing Q3 2026) will create a 1.1M oz/year producer. Massive revenue growth (+224%) and 59% gross margins are compelling, but the Q1 2026 EPS miss, all-share merger dilution (33%), and broken technical structure (below all EMAs, RSI 37.7) prevent a higher grade. Deep value play for gold bulls, not a momentum setup.

business.overview:
Equinox Gold is a mid-tier gold producer headquartered in Vancouver, operating mines across North America (Canada, USA, Mexico). The company produced a record 922,827 ounces in 2025 from a diversified portfolio including the flagship Greenstone Mine in Ontario.

In May 2026, Equinox announced a transformative all-share merger with Orla Mining, creating a senior gold producer with 1.1M oz annual production and a funded growth trajectory to 1.9M oz. The combined company will have a pure North American footprint — Brazil operations were sold in January 2026 for portfolio optimization, and $1.1B in debt was retired.

technicals.setupNote: Deeply oversold structure — price -46% from 52W high ($18.96), below all three EMAs. RSI 37.7 in oversold territory, MACD just crossing above signal line (early reversal signal). ATR $0.73 (7.1%) reflects high volatility. Key support at psychological $10 level. First resistance at EMA20 ($11.37). This is a contrarian mean-reversion setup, NOT a momentum play. Strong gold correlation (0.69 with GLD) means gold price direction is the primary driver.

risks.riskSummary: High-beta gold miner in a broken downtrend with pending merger dilution. Deep value metrics offset by execution risk and technical weakness.

riskCards.title: Orla Merger Dilution
points: All-share deal: Orla holders receive 1.00 EQX share per ORLA share
Existing EQX shareholders diluted to 67% of combined entity
Merger closing Q3 2026 — integration risk ahead
riskCards.verdict: Dilution is certain but strategic — creates 1.1M oz producer with growth to 1.9M oz. Market has priced in the overhang.

riskCards.title: Gold Price Sensitivity
points: Beta 2.33 amplifies gold moves in both directions
Gold pullback to $2,200 would compress margins significantly
riskCards.verdict: At current gold prices (~$2,700+), EQX margins are exceptional. Risk is asymmetric if gold reverses.

riskCards.title: Broken Technical Structure
points: Price below EMA20, EMA50, AND EMA200
RSI 37.7 — oversold but can stay oversold longer
riskCards.verdict: Contrarian entry — needs gold price strength or merger catalyst to reverse. Position sizing must reflect high volatility.

riskCards.title: Q1 2026 EPS Miss
points: Likely transitory — Brazil sale + integration costs
riskCards.verdict: One-quarter miss during transformational year is acceptable. Next quarter critical to re-establish trend.

tradeIdea.thesis: Equinox Gold trades at an extreme discount (6.4x fwd PE, 6.0x EV/EBITDA) for a gold producer with 59% gross margins and a transformative merger creating a 1.1M oz/year senior producer. The stock is deeply oversold (RSI 37.7) at -46% from its ATH, with strong gold correlation (0.69) in a structural gold bull market. The contrarian thesis: the Orla merger overhang and Q1 miss have pushed the stock to levels that discount far worse outcomes than reality.
